hero.title: A Git client for all your repositories and all your accounts
hero.subtitle: Git Rudder shows the history of every branch, resolves conflicts line by line and works with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea and Azure DevOps at once, with several accounts on each platform.
hero.vscodeLink: Also available as a VS Code extension

features.title: Everything you need to work with Git as a team

graph.title: Graph of every branch
graph.text: Commits, branches, tags and stashes in one view. Right-click to checkout, merge, rebase, cherry-pick or reset.

conflicts.title: Line-by-line conflicts
conflicts.text: Your version and the incoming one side by side, with the final result below. Add or remove each line with + and −.

accounts.title: Several accounts per platform
accounts.text: Personal, work and client accounts in one app. Each repository uses its own account for fetch, push and PRs.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.text: Group repos by project or team. A repo can belong to several workspaces, and you see all their pull requests together.

ai.title: AI with your own key
ai.text: Connect Anthropic, OpenAI, Groq or another provider to draft commit messages and pull request descriptions.

cloud.title: Your settings in the cloud
cloud.text: Sign in and your workspaces, linked accounts and preferences follow you to every machine and to VS Code.

vscode.title: Git Rudder inside VS Code
vscode.text: The graph, pending changes, the conflict resolver and AI, for the repository you have open. It uses your editor theme and language and the same Git Rudder account.
vscode.requirement: VS Code 1.140 or later. Not available on vscode.dev

download.title: Download Git Rudder

requirement.linux: Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+. .deb and .rpm packages do not update automatically

download.mobile: Git Rudder is a desktop app. Open this page on your computer to download it.

cta.title: Create your Git Rudder account
cta.text: With an account your workspaces, linked accounts and preferences sync between the desktop app and VS Code, and you can manage your team from the web.

auth.loginSubtitle: Access your settings and your team.
auth.signupSubtitle: Sync Git Rudder across your machines and work as a team.
auth.terms: I accept the terms of service and privacy policy.

error.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
error.name: Enter your name.
error.noApi: We can't reach Git Rudder. Try again in a few minutes.
error.expired: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
error.credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
error.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
error.server: Something went wrong at Git Rudder. Try again in a moment.
error.revokedElsewhere: Your session was ended from another device. Sign in again to continue.
error.tooManyAttempts_other: Too many attempts. Try again in {count} minutes.
error.tooManyAttempts_one: Too many attempts. Try again in {count} minute.

auth.resetSent: We sent you a password reset link.

recover.title: Reset your password
recover.subtitle: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to choose a new one.
recover.sent: If there's an account for {email}, a link will arrive in a few minutes. It expires in 30 minutes and works only once.
recover.spam: Not there? Check your spam folder or ask for another link.
recover.tooMany: You've asked for several links in a row. Wait a few minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.rules: The password must be 8 to 128 characters long.
reset.vaultNotice: This only changes the password you use to sign in to Git Rudder. It doesn't change your sync passphrase: your encrypted accounts and keys stay protected by it.
reset.sessionsNotice: Saving it signs you out on every device. Sign in again on each one; your sync passphrase brings your accounts and keys back there.
reset.done: You can now sign in with your new password. We signed you out on every device.
reset.dead: It may have expired (links last 30 minutes), already been used, or been replaced by a newer one.

verify.created: Account created. We sent you a link to confirm your email.
verify.banner: Confirm your email: we sent a link to {email}. Until then you can't create organizations or invite people.
verify.needed: Confirm your email to do this.
verify.done: You can now create organizations and invite your team.
verify.expiry: It expires after 48 hours and works only once.
verify.logInToResend: Sign in to ask for another link.
verify.tooMany: We've already sent several links. Wait a while before asking for another.

callback.signedIn: You can go back to the app and close this tab.
callback.cancelled: Go back to {client} if you want to try again.
callback.failed: {reason}. Go back to {client} and try again.
callback.staleTitle: This connection is no longer valid
callback.staleExpired: The link to connect your account expired or was already used. Go back to Git Rudder Desktop or VS Code and start again from Add account.
callback.staleUnknown: Something went wrong connecting the account. Go back to Git Rudder and try again.
callback.platformOk: Go back to Git Rudder to finish. You can close this tab.
callback.platformFailed: Reason: {reason}. Go back to Git Rudder and try again.

emailChange.done: From now on, sign in and get notices with your new email.
emailChange.taken: That address already has a Git Rudder account. The change wasn't applied.
emailChange.undoText: Your account will go back to this email and we'll end every session. Do it if you didn't ask for the change.
emailChange.undone: Done. Your account uses this email again and every session was ended. We recommend changing your password.

oauth.denied: You cancelled access at the provider. You can try again or sign in with your email.
oauth.failed: Signing in with the provider couldn't be completed. Try again.
oauth.accountExists: There's already a Git Rudder account with that email, but it isn't confirmed yet. Sign in with your password or use "Forgot it?" to recover it; then you can link this provider from Account.
oauth.unverifiedAtProvider: Your email isn't verified at the provider. Verify it there or sign up with your email.

finish.title: Finish creating your account
finish.organizationHint: We create the organization with a 14-day Git Rudder Pro trial, no card needed. You can leave it empty.
finish.expired: You have 15 minutes to finish it. Start again from Sign up.

authorize.logInFirst: Sign in to authorize {client} on this device.
authorize.title: Authorize {client}
authorize.text: {client} is asking for access to your Git Rudder account on this device.
authorize.deviceNote: Name the device reports. If you don't recognize it, cancel.
authorize.scope: It will be able to sync your workspaces, repositories, linked accounts and preferences with your account, and use your organizations' AI keys.
authorize.emailNotice: We'll email you about this new device. You can sign it out any time in {path}.
authorize.bad: Go back to Git Rudder and start again. If you got here from a link someone sent you, close it: it may be a phishing attempt.
authorize.backToVsCodeText: If your browser asks, allow it to open VS Code. Signing in finishes there; you can close this tab.
authorize.cancelled: Cancelled. You can close this tab.

deviceCode.logInFirst: Sign in to connect a device with a code.
deviceCode.title: Connect a device
deviceCode.text: Enter the code shown in Git Rudder for VS Code or Git Rudder Desktop.
deviceCode.format: The code has 8 letters, for example WDJB-MJHT.
deviceCode.warn: Only approve if you just requested this code on your own device. If someone sent or read it to you, reject it.
deviceCode.notFound: That code doesn't exist or has expired. Codes last 10 minutes; get a new one on your device.
deviceCode.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying another code.
deviceCode.approved: Done. Go back to your device: signing in finishes on its own in a few seconds.
deviceCode.rejected: Rejected. That device won't get access to your account.

reauth.title: Confirm it's you
reauth.for: To {action}, we need to confirm your identity.
reauth.providerNotEnough: GitHub and GitLab don't work for this action: they can't ask you to sign in again.
reauth.waiting: We sent a link to {maskedEmail}. Open it on any device; this window will continue on its own.
reauth.providerNotLinked: That {provider} account isn't linked to your Git Rudder account.
reauth.linkOk: Identity confirmed. Go back to the tab where you asked for it to continue.
reauth.linkDead: This link no longer works. It lasts 15 minutes and works only once. Ask for it again from Git Rudder.

dashboard.overviewSubtitle: This is what syncs to your devices.

workspaces.subtitle: Workspaces group repositories. Shared ones show up for the whole team.
workspaces.label: Workspaces

repos.subtitle: Repositories linked to your account. Local ones only exist on the device where they were added.

accounts.subtitle: Git platform accounts connected to Git Rudder. Tokens are stored encrypted.

team.subtitle: Members of {org}, their roles and invitations.

sync.subtitle: What is stored in your account and applied on each device when you sign in.
sync.accountsOff: Off: each device keeps its own accounts
sync.aiKeysOn: End-to-end encrypted with your sync passphrase
sync.aiKeysOff: Off: each device keeps its own keys
sync.appearanceDescription: VS Code always uses the editor theme
sync.exportDescription: Download a JSON with everything synced
sync.deleteAccountDescription: Deletes your account and cloud settings
sync.deleteConfirm: This cannot be undone. Repositories on disk are not touched.
sync.stopBody: Their details and encrypted copies are deleted from the cloud. Each device keeps its local copy and the account each repository uses.

status.title: Service status
status.subtitle: What the Git Rudder API is answering right now.
status.unreachableText: The API did not answer. It may be down or under maintenance.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: This address does not exist in Git Rudder.

vault.title: Vault
vault.none: Not set up. It's created in Git Rudder Desktop or VS Code the first time you sync an account or a key.
vault.help: Your accounts and keys travel encrypted with your sync passphrase. This website can't read them.

reset.title: Reset the vault?
reset.what: The encrypted copies of your linked accounts and AI keys are deleted from the cloud. Account details (platform, username and host) stay.
reset.noOne: Nobody can recover those copies, not even Git Rudder support.
reset.kept: Each device keeps its own credentials; the first one to create a new vault uploads its own again.
reset.tryFirst: First, try another way: if a device is still unlocked, change the passphrase there and you won't lose anything.
reset.done: Vault reset. We sent you a notification email.
reset.limit: Too many attempts. Try again in an hour.

vault.needsPassphrase: Requires your sync passphrase, set up in Git Rudder Desktop or VS Code. Until then, accounts sync without their tokens.

password.help: Used to sign in with your email.
password.noneHelp: Your account has no password: you sign in with {provider}. Add one so you can also sign in with your email.
password.note: It doesn't change your sync passphrase. We'll sign you out on your other devices and browsers.
password.changed: Password changed. We signed you out on your other devices.
password.added: Password added. You can now sign in with your email too.

identities.title: Sign-in methods
identities.subtitle: They let you sign in to Git Rudder. Accounts for cloning and pushing are in Linked accounts.
identities.linked: {provider} linked. We've emailed you about it.
identities.alreadyLinked: That {provider} account is already linked to another Git Rudder account.
identities.needsVerifiedEmail: Confirm your email to link another sign-in method.
identities.removeText: You won't be able to sign in with {provider} anymore. We'll email you about it.
identities.lastOne: It's your only way to sign in. Add a password or another identity before removing it.
